title: feat(app-shell): the notification bell opens a right-side full-height panel with pending approvals decidable in place
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB1jdeHZg99ncA7EGm9jPJB8)_
Fixes #34589
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfdKUNrJJjV88a19v2

Claim of record: the restated `Claim:` on the card, comment 6939068952 (branch `claude/project-thread-r5tewa`, this session).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:右上角铃铛不再弹 384px 的小浮层,而是从右侧整高展开一个 440px 的面板(手机上全屏);列表占满剩余高度。通知页签顶部新增「需要你处理」,每条待审批直接带「通过 / 驳回 / 查看详情」;「标为已读」改成悬停或聚焦时出现的勾选图标。
- 为什么改:维护者原话「右上角的消息通知点开之后弹出框有点小」「通知是否建议类似苹果桌面从右侧展开？」;旧浮层列表只有 320px,一屏约 3 条,审批还要跳到收件箱才能处理。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `@object-ui/app-shell` 的铃铛面板和审批共享读数(给每条待审批多带上服务端原行),加两个 i18n 文案键;不改通知数据、分组和三个页签。通过 / 驳回走的是审批请求自己声明的动作(与记录页同一条 `DeclaredActionsBar` 受管路径),没有新写审批客户端。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx` 的 `SheetContent`(非模态、无遮罩、点页面不关、遇记录抽屉让位)和 `handleApprovalDecided`;② 新文件 `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxApprovalItem.tsx`(`DeclaredActionsBar` 用 `list_item` 位置、以服务端原行作派发记录);③ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts` 中 `PendingApprovalRequest.row` 与 `refreshSharedPendingApprovals`。
- 两分钟验证:在仓根执行 `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/InboxPopover.rightPanel-34589.test.tsx`,预期 11 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx` (the bell; the component keeps its name and props, so both mounts, `AppHeader` and the `global:notifications` page block, keep working):

- The Radix `Popover` (`w-96`, lists capped at `max-h-80`) becomes a right-side `Sheet`: `inset-y-0 right-0 h-full`, `md:w-[440px]`, `w-full max-w-none` below `md` (full screen on a phone). Header, breakdown and tab strip stay fixed; each open tab is a flex column whose rows scroll in the remaining height, with its footer ("View all notifications" / "View all activity") pinned under them.
- The sheet is non-modal (`modal={false}`, `hideOverlay`) and `onInteractOutside` is prevented, so the page beside it stays usable and a click there neither closes the panel nor is swallowed. It closes from its close button, Escape or the bell.
- A followed notification link no longer closes the panel on desktop: the record opens in the page and the next notification is one click away. On a phone (`useIsMobile`) the panel covers the page, so it still closes. The linkless fallback and the three "view all" drills still close it (they open full pages).
- The panel yields to the record drawer: when `?recordId=` (`RECORD_DRAWER_PARAM`) appears in the URL, it closes, so the two never stack on the right.
- "Needs your action" heads the Notifications tab when requests are pending; the Approvals tab lists the same requests above its existing count and drill. The panel opens on the tab the existing opening rule picks (objectui#11698).
- A decided request is hidden at once (local overlay) and its share is taken off the badge, the breakdown and the tab pill until the feed's re-read drops it; `onApprovalDecided` asks the feed to re-read now.
- "Mark read" is an icon button (`Check`, accessible name kept: "Mark read" for a row, "Mark all of this type read" for a group) shown on hover or keyboard focus (`opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100`), and always shown below `md` with the 44 px tap floor. Unread single rows gain the lever too, as in the design picture. "Mark all read" stays.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxApprovalItem.tsx` (new): one pending request: the title Home's "My work" row uses (process label · record title), its age, the request's own declared actions through `DeclaredActionsBar` (`objectName: 'sys_approval_request'`, `location: 'list_item'`, `record`: the served row), and "View details", which opens `/apps/SEGMENT/system/approvals?request=ID`, Home's target for the same row. `approval_approve` and `approval_reject` are the actions `sys_approval_request` declares at `list_item`; their `visible` gates read the row's server-computed `viewer` block, and a request that asks for decision outputs collects them in the action's param dialog. No approvals client is written here.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts`: `PendingApprovalRequest` gains an optional `row` (the request row as `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests` served it, `viewer` block included; `ApprovalService.listRequests` attaches it on every list read). Added `refreshSharedPendingApprovals()`, the same one-shot re-read the push seam runs. No new request: it is the one shared approvals read the bell already makes.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useInboxBell.ts`: reads `useSharedPendingApprovalRequests` (the hook the count already came from) and returns `pendingApprovals` and `refreshPendingApprovals` beside the count. `AppHeader.tsx` and `views/global-notifications-renderer.tsx` pass both to the bell (two props each).

`ui/packages/i18n`: `notifications.needsYou` and `notifications.viewApprovalDetails` in every pack (zh-Hant regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`).

## Why

Maintainer, 2026-11-17 (epic #34571): 「右上角的消息通知点开之后弹出框有点小」「通知是否建议类似苹果桌面从右侧展开？」. The popover showed about three rows, and a pending approval only offered a link to the Approvals inbox.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/InboxPopover.rightPanel-34589.test.tsx` (real Radix sheet and tabs, real router and i18n pack; only `DeclaredActionsBar` stood in for, its own gates being pinned in its suites):

- right side, full height, `md:w-[440px]`, no `max-h-80`, no overlay mounted;
- a click in the page reaches the page and leaves the panel open;
- the panel closes when `?recordId=` appears;
- "Needs your action" is the first block of the Notifications scroll area, one item per request;
- each item mounts `DeclaredActionsBar` with `sys_approval_request`, `list_item` and the served row (identity);
- a decision drops the row and the badge (3 → 2) at once and calls `onApprovalDecided` once;
- "View details" navigates to `…/system/approvals?request=req-1` and the panel stays open;
- the Approvals tab lists the same requests;
- a followed notification link marks the row read, navigates, and leaves the panel open;
- "mark read" is a text-less icon with the hover/focus classes, offered on unread rows only;
- at 375 px: `w-full max-w-none h-full`, the icon shown and 44 px, and a followed link closes the panel.

Existing suites updated for the new primitive and behaviour: the eight `InboxPopover.*` suites that stub the popover now stub `Sheet*` and add `useLocation` to their router mock; `InboxPopover.linklessFallback`'s CONTROL now expects a followed link to leave the panel open; `InboxPopover.phoneWidth-29076`'s width pin reads the full-screen classes; `AppHeader.inboxVariant`, `AppHeader.deferredChromeReads-12980` and `sharedInboxFeed.twoSurfaces` stub `Sheet*`; `useHomeInbox.myWork-12602` expects the served `row` on each request.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1 (8 rows at 1440×900 without scrolling): NOT MEASURED in a browser, reason: no live console run in this card container. Reading of the classes: the list has the window height less header, breakdown, tab strip, filter and footer (about 175 px), so about 725 px at 900; a row with a one-line body is about 70 px.
- Acceptance 2–4 are pinned in the new suite (decided row and badge, record opens with the panel open, full screen at 375).
- Card item 5 (the panel yields to the record drawer) is keyed on the drawer's URL param; the record-form overlay (`?form=`) is a centred dialog and is not handled.
- The pinned list is the first page the shared read asks for (`APPROVALS_PAGE_ROWS`, 5); when more are waiting, the Approvals tab's count and "View approvals" drill show the total.
- Design picture items not taken: the "Today / Earlier" date headers (the card keeps the grouping unchanged) and the submitter/amount line (the list row's fields vary by process; the title is Home's).

## Verification

Readings against head `a8d27480` (base `082f9c29`).

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

Run from `ui/` as vitest root, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (VERDICT command-exit 0).

- `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/InboxPopover packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.inboxVariant.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.deferredChromeReads-12980.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/sharedInboxFeed.twoSurfaces.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useHomeInbox.myWork-12602.test.tsx` → `Test Files  18 passed (18)`, `Tests  169 passed (169)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Before those fixes, the wider run over `layout/__tests__/InboxPopover*`, both `AppHeader` inbox suites, `hooks/__tests__/` and `views/global-notifications*`: `Test Files  5 failed | 105 passed (110)`, all five being the suites listed above as updated.
- `vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts` → 102 of 103 files passed; the one red was `zh-hant-generated` (zh-Hant not regenerated), fixed by `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run gen:zh-hant`; re-run of `zh-hant-generated` + `all-locales-key-parity` → `Tests  59 passed (59)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` → VERDICT command-exit 0 (both packages' `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`).
- `npx eslint` over every changed app-shell file → exit 0 (0 errors; warnings are the files' existing `no-explicit-any`).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per behaviour the diff changes; each mutation landed and was restored, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

Through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `InboxPopover.tsx`, running the new suite (src-imported, no build in the path):

- delete `onInteractOutside={(e) => e.preventDefault()}` → `stays open when the page beside it is clicked` red (1 failed | 10 passed). A first run passed because the click came before Radix armed its outside listener; the test now waits a task, and the re-run went red.
- delete `if (drawerRecordId) setOpen(false);` → `yields when the record drawer opens` red (1 failed | 10 passed).
- delete `setDecidedIds((prev) => new Set(prev).add(r.id));` → `drops a decided request and its share of the badge` red (1 failed | 10 passed).

</details>
